steps: Navigate from one existing conversation to the controlled target conversation.
Wait for the target conversation fetch to complete.
Disarm protocol-read capture and export once.

semantic_assessment.reason: A controlled navigation from one existing conversation to another produced one GET conversation-fetch request followed by the target navigation event and a successful HTTP 200 JSON response containing the target conversation envelope. The committed evidence preserves only value-minimized structure.

causal_selection.navigation_relation: request observed while transitioning from one existing conversation to the controlled target; navigation event identified the target before the response completed.

limitations: One successful controlled observation does not establish cross-deployment stability.
The response body is committed only as placeholder-only structural evidence; message semantics are not yet imported.
The snapshot does not establish complete conversation-list enumeration; C01 remains NoBaseline.
The private raw export contains unrelated account and conversation material and is not publication-safe.
